title: pellaea concolor
intro: Pellaea concolor, commonly known as Mountain chain fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, improve liver function, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea concolor include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antiseptic, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Pellaea concolor include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
